name: Digital Identity Anchor (UNTP)
description: UN Transparency Protocol 0.8.0 Digital Identity Anchor: a registrar binds a DID to an identity in its register.
summary: Credential type template for the UNTP 0.8.0 DigitalIdentityAnchor, a profile of the W3C Recognized Entities RecognizedEntityCredential (jwt_vc_vcdm, UNTP 0.8.0 schema). A UNTP registrar wallet issues it to a member DID through its built-in untp-dia issuer, not a configured one; the member holds it and publishes it as a "dia" link in its DID document. The template is what lets Nexus show a held DIA: the recognized entity (DID and name) and its registrations (registered ID and name, register and register type, control type). Issued by the untp/registrar wallet template.
